description: A FastAPI application demonstrating the use of background tasks to perform async logging and notification sending.

methods.name: write_log(message: str)
methods.description: Writes a log message to log.txt file asynchronously via background tasks.

methods.name: get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Dependency that processes the query parameter and adds a background task to log it.

methods.name: send_notification( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str = Depends(get_query) )
methods.description: FastAPI route handler that schedules a background task to write a message to log.txt and returns a confirmation message.

ctags.name: get_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str | None = None):$/

ctags.name: send_notification
ctags.signature: ( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str = Depends(get_query) )
